profile: packaged debug app with optimized first-party crates, real WKWebView with observed visibility, scripted manual refresh/interaction; no GPU/JS-heap measurement, provider/network or cross-product comparison
attribution: Native RSS is exact PID. WebKit RSS includes new WebKit helpers absent before launch; XPC parentage cannot exclude unrelated helpers launched during the interval. Git RSS is sampled descendants only and can miss short-lived peaks. Summed RSS may double-count shared pages; it is not JS heap or total GPU allocation.
idle_sleep_guard: Temporary task-owned caffeinate -di tied to native PID; prevents display idle sleep only during foreground sampling; no preferences changed or session unlocked
